summary: Maintain mail delivery objectives from changed messages and recipient coverage instead of rebuilding every retained lifecycle

replay.detail: The producer initializes its in-memory reductions from the existing retained mail source, acceptance and lifecycle ledgers. No durable facts are rewritten.

schema.detail: No persisted schema or migration changes. Changed-subject routing and bounded generation journals are process-local.

rules.detail: Original durable send onsets, explicit holds, certified native acceptance, terminal failures, retention and native-frontier freshness remain authoritative. Genuine lifecycle and accounting boundaries are retained; producer heartbeats cannot extend native coverage.

compatibility.detail: Mail source commits replace only their affected message reductions. Recipient frontier changes reuse retained source and lifecycle facts. Identity, schema, lost-key and journal-rollover cuts require a full rebuild. Cumulative work counters expose full rebuilds, message evaluations, source rows, acceptance rows, lifecycle rows and owner lookups. Mail-owned episode evaluation no longer assembles unrelated SLO sources or evaluates unrelated declared objectives.

downtime.detail: Normal binary rollout; the initial producer capture rebuilds its reductions.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual backfill is required.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback restores full captures without changing retained source facts.
